content: ExclusiveArea is entered and exited by a common set of APIs If the value of attribute SwcExclusiveAreaPolicy . apiPrinciple is set to ApiPrincipleEnum . common then the RTE provides one set of enter and exit APIs to be shared among all RunnableEntity s of the whole software-component.
